# Huron County Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Huron County. Furnace repair covers diagnosing and correcting faults in gas, propane, and oil furnaces, including ignition, electrical, motor, and control problems.

Email: contact@huroncountyheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://huroncountyheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Goderich, Clinton, Exeter, Seaforth, Wingham, Bayfield, Blyth, Hensall. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://huroncountyheatingcooling.ca/): Service request overview and equipment guidance
- [About](https://huroncountyheatingcooling.ca/about/): Website and inquiry process
- [Contact](https://huroncountyheatingcooling.ca/contact/): Submit a service inquiry
